description: This PHP class defines a wizard for formatting time strings within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides constants for time format components, manages separators and format blocks, and constructs time format strings.

classes.name: Time
classes.description: A class for constructing time format strings with customizable separators and blocks, extending DateTimeWizard.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Time wizard instance with optional separators and format blocks.

methods.name: mapFormatBlocks
methods.description: Maps format block strings to their normalized form, wrapping literals or converting case as needed.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Generates and returns the combined time format string.
